scientific_integrity: The seven low-degree certificates and the degree-eight base inequality are exact; higher-degree monotonicity, all-degree coefficient formula, and asymptotics are proved analytically. No independent verification or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Real canonical right-continuous BV functions with endpoint continuity, unweighted Lebesgue L1 error, classical point-sampling MKZ; all-degree finite maxima given algorithmically, global finite-degree index/equality classification for n>=8 not proved. A 2000 related article is recorded without an exact day-verified public availability date; September 17, 2008 is the earliest verified calendar-day source used for archive eligibility, not an assertion of historical invention priority.
title: Sharp integrated BV error of Meyer–König–Zeller averaging: a degree-eight boundary transition
